implemented_requirements.evidence: card.py defines a Card class with rank, suit, value, comparison operators and a build_deck() function that creates the full 54‑card Dou Dizhu deck.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Definition of all combination types and comparison logic
implemented_requirements.evidence: combination.py implements a Combination class that classifies cards into singles, pairs, trios, straights, bombs, rockets, etc., and provides a beats() method that encodes the pass‑or‑beat rules.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Constants for ranks, values and combination identifiers
implemented_requirements.evidence: constants.py lists RANK_ORDER, RANK_VALUE, joker values, MAX_STRAIGHT_VALUE and string identifiers for every combination type.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Bidding phase to determine the landlord
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.bid() in game.py runs a three‑player bidding loop, uses a simple hand‑strength heuristic for AI, selects a landlord, and gives the landlord the kitty cards.
Game class has no method that iterates player turns, asks for moves, validates them against the last combination, or handles passing. The required logic is missing.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Move generation for a hand (enumerate legal combinations)
implemented_requirements.evidence: moves.py contains only a stub for _consecutive_runs and does not define generate_moves or find_moves; the file ends with an ellipsis placeholder.
game.py imports Player from player.py, but player.py is not provided, so no evidence of a Player class implementation.
No code in any file checks for an empty hand or declares a winner.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Executable entry point to start a match
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py only re‑defines constants; it does not import Game or start a game loop.

critical_issues: Missing player.py – no Player class to hold hands, track landlord status, or provide AI/human move input.
moves.py is incomplete; generate_moves and find_moves are not implemented, and helper functions contain placeholder ellipsis.
Game class lacks the core gameplay loop: no method to prompt/receive moves, enforce pass‑or‑beat, update last_combination, or detect when a player runs out of cards.
No win‑condition logic; the program never determines a winner.
main.py does not launch the game, making the package non‑executable as‑is.
judge.summary: The repository contains a solid foundation for card representation, deck building, combination detection, and a bidding phase, but it is missing the majority of the gameplay engine: player handling, move generation, turn sequencing, pass‑or‑beat enforcement, and win detection. Because essential components are absent or only stubbed, the implementation does not satisfy the core Dou Dizhu requirements and is unlikely to run successfully.
